items.source: AggregationExpression for $ltrim which removes whitespace or the specified characters from the beginning of a string.
items.translation: AggregationExpression 用于 $ltrim，该操作符从字符串开头移除空格或指定的字符。

items.source: AggregationExpression for $regexFind which applies a regular expression (regex) to a string and returns information on the first matched substring.
items.translation: AggregationExpression 用于 $regexFind，该操作对字符串应用正则表达式（regex），并返回第一个匹配子串的信息。

items.source: AggregationExpression for $regexFindAll which applies a regular expression (regex) to a string and returns information on all the matched substrings.
items.translation: AggregationExpression 用于 $regexFindAll，该操作对字符串应用正则表达式（regex），并返回所有匹配子串的信息。

items.source: AggregationExpression for $regexMatch which applies a regular expression (regex) to a string and returns a boolean that indicates if a match is found or not.
items.translation: AggregationExpression 用于 $regexMatch，该操作符对字符串应用正则表达式（regex），并返回一个布尔值以指示是否找到匹配项。

items.source: AggregationExpression for $replaceAll which replaces all instances of a search string in an input string with a replacement string.
items.translation: AggregationExpression 用于 $replaceAll，该操作将输入字符串中所有搜索字符串的实例替换为替换字符串。

items.source: AggregationExpression for $replaceOne which replaces the first instance of a search string in an input string with a replacement string.
items.translation: AggregationExpression 用于 $replaceOne，该操作将输入字符串中搜索字符串的第一个实例替换为替换字符串。

items.source: AggregationExpression for $rtrim which removes whitespace or the specified characters from the end of a string.
items.translation: AggregationExpression 用于 $rtrim，该操作从字符串末尾删除空白字符或指定的字符。

items.source: AggregationExpression for $trim which removes whitespace or the specified characters from the beginning and end of a string.
items.translation: AggregationExpression 用于 $trim，该操作可移除字符串开头和结尾处的空白或指定字符。
